name: dagsec
description: Stops Claude Code from installing packages that don't exist or have critical vulnerabilities, and lets it check any npm, PyPI, crates.io, Go, Maven or NuGet package before adding it.

api_key.title: dagsec API key
api_key.description: Create one at https://app.dagsec.net/keys (starts with dgs_).

mode.title: When an install is risky
mode.description: block: stop the install and tell Claude why. warn: ask you before it runs.
